conclusions: The Error data field initializes to undefined before capture; its tag alone does not identify a completed fallback capture.
Successful native-hook recursion capture publishes either actual frames or disabled-capture undefined. An explicit presence marker can distinguish this from initialization without guest observation.
The existing reader remains a legacy duplicate API. A new raw query must use actual capture presence; adoption may transfer the old native entitlement only after real Map publication.
The actual js_map_get operation has no callback or allocation after intrinsic class validation. The new proposed raw seam will preserve its normalization/hash/search and add no pending operation.
Script32 already supplies a raw opaque-frame Script/position projection, independently owned from JS receiver/function roots.
